import resource
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
import json,multiprocessing as mp,torch,networkx as nx,pandas as pd
import torch.distributions as D
import scglue
from scglue.models.nn import autodevice
from scglue.models.sc import GraphEncoder,GraphDecoder,NBDataDecoder
from scglue.models.data import GraphDataset
from ignite.handlers import TerminateOnNan
from types import SimpleNamespace
assert torch.cuda.is_available()
torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()
assert str(autodevice())=='cuda'
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print(json.dumps({'stage':'CUDA/autodevice ready','workers':0,'start_method':mp.get_start_method()}),flush=True)
n=32000;latent=30;batch=128
encoder=GraphEncoder(n,latent).to('cuda')
decoders=[NBDataDecoder(width).to('cuda') for width in (2000,15000,15000)]
params=list(encoder.parameters())+[p for decoder in decoders for p in decoder.parameters()]
optimizer=torch.optim.Adam(params,lr=.002)
eidx=torch.stack((torch.arange(n,device='cuda'),torch.arange(n,device='cuda').roll(1)))
weights=torch.ones(n,device='cuda')
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('modules initialized before graph worker',flush=True)
graph=nx.DiGraph()
for i in range(n):
 graph.add_edge(str(i),str(i),weight=1.0,sign=1)
 graph.add_edge(str(i),str((i+1)%n),weight=1.0,sign=1)
dataset=GraphDataset(graph,pd.Index([str(i) for i in range(n)]),'weight','sign',neg_samples=10,getitem_size=8192)
dataset.prepare_shuffle(num_workers=0,random_seed=0)
dataset.shuffle()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('full-shape CPU graph shuffle and parent CUDA synchronized',flush=True)
try:
 posterior=encoder(eidx,weights,weights)
 v=posterior.rsample()
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 print('32000x30 native graph convolution synchronized',flush=True)
 sample,targets,signs=[x.pin_memory().to('cuda',non_blocking=True) for x in dataset[0]]
 gl=-GraphDecoder()(v,sample,signs).log_prob(targets)
 bins=(targets!=0).long();sums=torch.zeros(2,device='cuda');sums.scatter_add_(0,bins,gl)
 loss=sums.mean()/8192+D.kl_divergence(posterior,D.Normal(0,1)).mean()
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 print('8192-edge Bernoulli/scatter graph loss synchronized',flush=True)
 for index,(width,decoder) in enumerate(zip((2000,15000,15000),decoders)):
  x=torch.ones((batch,width)).pin_memory().to('cuda',non_blocking=True)
  u=torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn((batch,latent),device='cuda'),dim=1)
  nb=decoder(u,v[:width],torch.zeros(batch,device='cuda',dtype=torch.long),torch.ones((batch,1),device='cuda')*width)
  loss=loss-nb.log_prob(x).mean()
  torch.cuda.synchronize()
  print(f'NB likelihood {index} 128x{width} synchronized',flush=True)
 loss.backward()
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 print('full-shape native backward synchronized',flush=True)
 optimizer.step()
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 print('single diagnostic Adam operation synchronized',flush=True)
 TerminateOnNan()(SimpleNamespace(state=SimpleNamespace(output={'loss':loss}),terminate=lambda:None))
 assert bool(torch.isfinite(loss))
 print(json.dumps({'stage':'complete','finite':True,'loss':loss.detach().item(),'max_memory_allocated':torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()}),flush=True)
finally:
 dataset.clean()
 del dataset
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 print('graph worker cleanup and final CUDA synchronized',flush=True)
